 Bigsound Festival 
 Siloé joins BIGSOUND Valencia 2027 in Torrent: their only festival date in the province and an indie twist to the line-up
 Redacción ModoFestival · Editor: Clara Belmonte 
 4 Nov 2026, 17:44 
 A 3-minute read 
 Pedro J Pacheco / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0) 
 Follow us on Google 
 In short
 Siloé join BIGSOUND Valencia 2027 , on 18 and 19 June at the Parc Central de Torrent, in what the organisers say will be their only festival performance in the province of Valencia that year. 
 They are the first independent pop-rock name on a line-up headlined by Becky G and Luis Fonsi , and the news comes while the Festival de les Arts has yet to announce an edition for 2027. 
 The general festival pass is still €60 , with the €70 tier marked as ‘coming soon’; residents registered in Torrent get a 20% discount until Sunday 8 November, according to the Town Council. 
 In the Valencian Community, Siloé will also play FIB and Low Festival , in addition to their concert at the Roig Arena in October 2027. 
 Siloé will be at BIGSOUND Valencia 2027 . On Wednesday the festival announced the Valladolid band as a new addition to its seventh edition, which takes place on Friday 18 and Saturday 19 June at the Parc Central de Torrent . According to the organisers, it will be the group's only festival performance in the province of Valencia in 2027.
 Festival guide 
 Bigsound Festival 2027 
 18–19 Jun 2027 · Parc Central de Torrent, Torrent 
 Tickets 
 Disponibles 
 Siloé at BIGSOUND Valencia 2027: what we know
 The festival has not yet said which day Siloé will play or at what time: there is still no day-by-day breakdown for any of the artists. The organisers present the booking as a boost to a ‘cross-cutting and intergenerational’ line-up and describe the group as being at their peak.
 Siloé , Fito Robles's band, are in the middle of the tour for «Terrorismo emocional», their fifth album, released in May 2026. The 2027 tour visits fifteen Spanish cities, including two nights at Madrid's Movistar Arena in March, and wraps up in autumn with dates at the Roig Arena in València and the Navarra Arena in Pamplona. According to the BIGSOUND organisers, the Roig Arena concert practically sold out within a few minutes.
 Siloé at Brisa Festival 2026. Image: Pedro J Pacheco / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0). An indie name on a Latin pop line-up
 Siloé change the tone of the line-up. The first announcement, on 20 October , focused on the international Latin pop of Becky G and Luis Fonsi , with Delaossa , Leire Martínez , Alizzz , Queralt Lahoz and Fran Perea among the Spanish acts. With Siloé, according to the organisers themselves, the festival opens up its line-up to alternative pop-rock and indie, the style missing from that first announcement.
 The announcement comes amid a gap in the city's calendar. The Festival de les Arts , València's big indie event, lost its Saturday at the Ciutat de les Arts i les Ciències in 2026 because of the noise dispute and has not announced dates or a venue for 2027. As of 13 October, CACSA, the public company that manages the complex, had not received any request for space for that year, according to Valencia Plaza. BIGSOUND also had to leave that venue, as we reported in our round-up of the festivals that left the Ciutat de les Arts , and moved to Torrent in 2026.
 BIGSOUND Valencia 2027 passes and the Torrent discount
 Tickets are sold through the official BIGSOUND Valencia ticket page , which redirects to the ticketing platform Enterticket. These are the passes on sale on the afternoon of 4 November, booking fees included:
 General pass, €60. The next tier, at €70, is listed as ‘coming soon’, with no date.
 Front Stage pass, €139.90 , with a fast-track lane and access to the front rows of the Turia stage.
 Vipsound pass, €230 , with a VIP platform, Front Stage and four drinks.
 General PMR pass, €60 , for people with reduced mobility.
 People registered as residents in Torrent can buy with a 20% discount until Sunday 8 November , according to the Town Council. Neither the Town Council nor the festival has specified in its announcement how proof of residence is provided.
 Siloé at festivals in the Valencian Community in 2027
 The exclusivity announced by BIGSOUND refers to the province of Valencia. Elsewhere in the region, Siloé also appear on the first line-up of FIB 2027 , in Benicàssim, and on that of Low Festival 2027 , in Torrevieja. Everything we know about the Torrent edition is on the BIGSOUND Valencia festival page , and the rest of that month's events are in our guide to festivals in the Valencian Community in June .
 Sources: official BIGSOUND Valencia website and Enterticket sales page, consulted on 4 November 2026; Valencia Plaza, Actualidad Valencia and El Debate (4 November 2026); Valencia Plaza (13 October 2026), on the Festival de les Arts; La Ganzúa (30 September 2026), on Siloé's tour.
